title: ION Trade Commitment Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 mirror of the trade/commitment/v1 OpenAPI schema pack. The root resolves to IONTradeCommitment; TradeCommitment provides the network-agnostic layer inherited from RetailCommitment v2.1.

TradeCommitment.title: TradeCommitment
TradeCommitment.description: Network-agnostic generic layer for TradeCommitment. Inherits RetailCommitment v2.1 and carries no Indonesia-specific regulatory or compliance fields.

replacementPreferred.description: Whether the buyer prefers replacement over refund for this committed line if the supplied resource is defective, incorrect, or otherwise eligible for remediation. This is line-specific because different commitments in the same contract may require different remedies.
